rule: Metric sequence resolved ONCE PER SERIES
specification: The primary ranking metric is chosen at series level from metrics computable for ALL 15 models; it is never chosen per model
rationale: THE DEFECT FIX. P6 resolved the fallback per model, so a model could win merely because its metric happened to be computable while better models fell through

rule: A metric must be computable for all 15 models to be used
specification: If any of the 15 models has a non-computable value, the metric is skipped entirely for that series
rationale: Comparing a computed value against a missing one is not a comparison

rule: A constant metric cannot be the primary metric
specification: A metric with a single distinct value across the 15 models is skipped as primary; the first discriminating metric is recorded instead
rationale: A metric that is identical for every model carries no ranking information; labelling it primary would misrepresent how the champion was chosen

specification: wape, smape, rmse, mae, median_absolute_error, negative_prediction_count, extreme_ratio_count
rationale: WAPE is scale-free and robust when actuals are nonzero

specification: mae, rmse, median_absolute_error, smape, negative_prediction_count, extreme_ratio_count
rationale: WAPE and MAPE are structurally undefined when every actual is zero; MAE is the only meaningful error measure

specification: ETS Explicit > ARIMA_Fixed > AutoARIMA > ETS_Current > Theta > LinearRegression > LightGBM > XGBoost > FixedGrowth_3 > FixedGrowth_4 > FixedGrowth_6 > FixedGrowth_1_5 > NLIN-DLIN_FIXED > SMLP-TCN > FNAR-V2
rationale: Applied ONLY after every numeric metric ties. ETS Explicit is the governance reference baseline; FNAR-V2 is last so it cannot win on availability

specification: The tie-break index is the final sort key, after all metric keys
rationale: Ordering preference must never beat a genuinely lower error
A no-signal series still needs one technical champion for schema consistency, but the Viewer must not present it as a recommendation

specification: P6C reads accuracy_metrics and reorders only
rationale: Keeps the correction auditable and bounded to the ranking layer

rule: Policy version stamped on every row
rationale: Lets P7 and the Viewer assert which policy produced a ranking
